WITH ssr AS (
    SELECT st.s_store_id,
           SUM(x.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(x.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(x.return_amt) AS `returns`,
           SUM(x.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT ss.ss_store_sk AS store_sk,
               ss.ss_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               ss.ss_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM store_sales ss
        JOIN date_dim dd
          ON ss.ss_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
         AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT sr.sr_store_sk AS store_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               sr.sr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               sr.sr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM store_returns sr
        JOIN date_dim dd
          ON sr.sr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
         AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
    ) AS x
    JOIN store st
      ON x.store_sk = st.s_store_sk
    GROUP BY st.s_store_id
),
csr AS (
    SELECT cp.cp_catalog_page_id,
           SUM(x.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(x.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(x.return_amt) AS `returns`,
           SUM(x.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT cs.cs_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               cs.cs_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               cs.cs_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_sales cs
        JOIN date_dim dd
          ON cs.cs_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
         AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT cr.cr_catalog_page_sk AS page_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               cr.cr_return_amount AS return_amt,
               cr.cr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM catalog_returns cr
        JOIN date_dim dd
          ON cr.cr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
         AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
    ) AS x
    JOIN catalog_page cp
      ON x.page_sk = cp.cp_catalog_page_sk
    GROUP BY cp.cp_catalog_page_id
),
wsr AS (
    SELECT ws.web_site_id,
           SUM(x.sales_price) AS sales,
           SUM(x.profit) AS profit,
           SUM(x.return_amt) AS `returns`,
           SUM(x.net_loss) AS profit_loss
    FROM (
        SELECT wsl.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               wsl.ws_ext_sales_price AS sales_price,
               wsl.ws_net_profit AS profit,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS return_amt,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS net_loss
        FROM web_sales wsl
        JOIN date_dim dd
          ON wsl.ws_sold_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
         AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
        UNION ALL
        SELECT wsl.ws_web_site_sk AS wsr_web_site_sk,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS sales_price,
               CAST(0 AS DECIMAL(7,2)) AS profit,
               wr.wr_return_amt AS return_amt,
               wr.wr_net_loss AS net_loss
        FROM web_returns wr
        JOIN web_sales wsl
          ON wr.wr_item_sk = wsl.ws_item_sk
         AND wr.wr_order_number = wsl.ws_order_number
        JOIN date_dim dd
          ON wr.wr_returned_date_sk = dd.d_date_sk
         AND dd.d_date BETWEEN CAST('2000-08-19' AS DATE) AND CAST('2000-09-02' AS DATE)
    ) AS x
    JOIN web_site ws
      ON x.wsr_web_site_sk = ws.web_site_sk
    GROUP BY ws.web_site_id
)
SELECT channel,
       id,
       SUM(sales) AS sales,
       SUM(`returns`) AS `returns`,
       SUM(profit) AS profit
FROM (
    SELECT 'store channel' AS channel,
           CONCAT('store', st.s_store_id) AS id,
           st.sales AS sales,
           st.`returns` AS `returns`,
           (st.profit - st.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM ssr st
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'catalog channel' AS channel,
           CONCAT('catalog_page', cp.cp_catalog_page_id) AS id,
           cp.sales AS sales,
           cp.`returns` AS `returns`,
           (cp.profit - cp.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM csr cp
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'web channel' AS channel,
           CONCAT('web_site', ws.web_site_id) AS id,
           ws.sales AS sales,
           ws.`returns` AS `returns`,
           (ws.profit - ws.profit_loss) AS profit
    FROM wsr ws
) AS x
GROUP BY channel, id WITH ROLLUP
ORDER BY channel, id
LIMIT 100
